content.text: Bɔ̃rurobɑ bɛɛ be i wɑ̃ɑ Siɔniɔ bɔri yɛndu sɔɔ,
kɑ bɛɛ be i sɔ̃ Sɑmɑrin ɡuurɔ kɑ toro sindu.
Mɑ i tɑmɑɑ i sɑ̃ɑ bwese te tɑ kpɑ̃ɑru bon wiruɡibu.
Mɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ somiru mɑrɑ bɛɛn min di.
I doo Kɑlinɛɔ i wɑ.
Min di, kpɑ i dɑ Hɑmɑtiɔ wuu bɔkɔ ɡen mi.
Kpɑ i sɑrɑ i dɑ Gɑtiɔ Filisitibɑn temɔ.
Ben wuu si, su bɛɛ Isirelibɑ kɑ Yudɑbɑn wusu ɡeɑ turɑ?
Ben tem mɛ, mu bɛɛn tem kpɑ̃ɑru turɑ?
Wee i ǹ kĩ wɑhɑlɑn tɔ̃ru tu bɛɛ nɑɑwɑ.
Mɑ i sere tii dɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ ɡɑwemɔ.
Mɑ yɑ bɑndu dii bɛɛn suunu sɔɔ.
Mɑ i kpĩ sɑu kpin yee burɑnu sɔɔ, nì bɑ burɑru kuɑ kɑ suunu donnu.
I tii yɑ̃ɑ kpɛmminu kɑ nɑɑ kpɛmi yi yi ɡum mɔ ɡɔsiɑmmɛ ɡɔ̃sun di i temmɔ.
I mɔrɔkunu soomɔ i womusu mɔ̀ bwisikunu sɑriru sɔɔ.
Mɑ i tɑmɑɑ i nin soberu yɛ̃wɑ nɡe Dɑfidi.
I tɑm nɔrumɔ kɑ nɔri bɛkɛ.
I tii ɡum turɑreɡim sɑwɑmɔ.
Mɑ i ǹ nuki sɑnkire yèn sɔ̃ bɛɛn bweseru tɑ koo kɑm ko.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ bɑ koo ɡbi bu bɛɛ yoru mwɛɛri bu kɑ doonɑ
kpɑ bɛɛn nuku dobun kuuki kɑ bɛɛn tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑ dim mu kpe.
Gusunɔ wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni u bɔ̃ruɑ kɑ win tiin wɑ̃ɑru u nɛɛ,
u ǹ bɛɛ Isirelibɑn tii suɑbu kĩ.
U mɑɑ bɛɛn sinɑ kpɑɑnu tusɑ.
U koo de bu Sɑmɑri mwɑ kɑ ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ ye sɔɔ kpuro.

content: Tɔmbu wɔkuru bɑ̀ n tie yɛnu ɡɑɡu sɔɔ, bɑ koo ɡbiwɑ.

Goo ù n win tɔnun ɡoru suɑ yɛnun di u kɑ yɑrɑ u dɔɔ u dɔ̃ɔ mɛni, u koo wi u wɑ̃ɑ yɛnu sɔɔwɔ bikiɑ u nɛɛ, ɡoo mɑɑ tie u wɑ̃ɑ kɑ wunɛ? Kpɑ yɛ̃ro u nùn wisi u nɛɛ, ɡoo sɑri. Kpɑ wini u nɛɛ, ɑ mɑrio. N ǹ weenɛ su Gusunɔn yĩsiru siɑ sɑɑ yeni sɔɔ kpɑ u sun sĩiremɑ.

content.text: Domi Yinni Gusunɔ u woodɑ yeni wɛ̃ u nɛɛ,
u koo yɛnusu kpuro kɔsukuwɑ, bɑkɑsu kɑ piiminu.
Bɑ rɑ dumi yɑkie kpee sɑɑrɑ wɔllɔ?
Bɑ rɑ kɑ nɛɛ wuku mi?
Adɑmɑ wee bɛɛ i ɡem ɡɔsiɑ dɛ̃ɛ.
Mɑ i ɡeɑ ɡɔsiɑ ɡɑ̃ɑ sosurɑnu.

content: Bɛɛ i nuku dobu mɔ̀ kɑm sɔɔ, mɑ i ɡerumɔ i mɔ̀, bɛɛn tiin dɑmɑ i kɑ nɑsɑrɑ wɑ.

Yen sɔ̃nɑ Gusunɔ wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni u nɛɛ, u koo de bwese tukuru ɡɑru tu bɛɛ seesi. Kpɑ tu bɛɛ dɑm dɔre sɑɑ Hɑmɑtin duu yerun di sere n kɑ dɑ nim torɑɔ ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ ɡbɑburun berɑ ɡiɑ mi ɡɑ̃ɑnu ku rɑ kpi.
